name: ms-self-train-8gpu
description: Unified multi-select decision model, soft self-teacher targets from data/multiselect/self_teacher_train.jsonl, full-rank FSDP on Qwen3.5-4B, SII readout recipe, 8xH100. Output runs/qz/ms_self/v1.
command:
set -uo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare
V=$R/.venv-sii
mkdir -p $R/logs/qz $R/runs/qz
cd $R
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
OUT=$R/runs/qz/ms_self/v1
TARGETS=$R/data/multiselect/self_teacher_train.jsonl
"$V/bin/python" -I "$R/harness/train_multiselect.py" --validate-only \
  --train "$R/data/multiselect/train.jsonl" --dev "$R/data/multiselect/dev.jsonl" \
  --model "$R/models/Qwen3.5-4B" --modules "$R/innerjev/configs/4B/modules.json" \
  --target file --target-file "$TARGETS" --world-size 8 --global-batch 64 \
  --max-input-tokens 8192 --max-batch-tokens 8192 \
  --validate-output "$R/logs/qz/ms_self_validate.json" \
  || { echo "validation failed (is $TARGETS present?)"; exit 3; }
mkdir -p "$OUT"
"$V/bin/torchrun" --standalone --nnodes 1 --nproc_per_node 8 \
  "$R/harness/train_multiselect.py" \
  --train "$R/data/multiselect/train.jsonl" \
  --dev "$R/data/multiselect/dev.jsonl" \
  --model "$R/models/Qwen3.5-4B" \
  --modules "$R/innerjev/configs/4B/modules.json" \
  --target file --target-file "$TARGETS" \
  --output "$OUT" \
  --lr 2e-6 --global-batch 64 --epochs 1 \
  --max-input-tokens 8192 --max-batch-tokens 8192 \
  --eval-every-frac 0.1 --lambda-g 0 --graph none \
  --seed 43 --expect-trainable 3313500160 \
  > "$R/logs/qz/ms_self_train.log" 2>&1
status=$?
echo "JOB EXIT=$status"
exit $status
